polityNote: Madagascar (Malagasy Republic) since independence 1960-06-26. NE depicts the 22 regions of 2004 (first-level since 2009); the six provinces 1960–2009 are unions of them.

sources.title: Statoids — Provinces of Madagascar (change history)
sources.says: Lists only renamings of the six provinces (1975, ~1980) and their 2000 autonomous status; no boundary change between provinces is recorded.

sources.title: Statoids — Regions of Madagascar (fivondronana 2000–2004 with their province and new region)
sources.says: Each of the 111 fivondronana is coded by province and assigned to one of the 22 regions of law 2004-001; every region code carries its province code.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Provinces of Madagascar (oldid 1373981556)
sources.says: Six provinces existed since before 1957; the 4 April 2007 referendum removed them, with a transition until October 2009; regions are now the main level.

spans.dateNote: Union of the 2004 regions, which were built from fivondronana that each lay in one province (statoids ymg). No inter-provincial transfer is recorded 1960–2009. End: the constitutional transition after the 2007 referendum ran until October 2009 (month precision).
